nodes.title: Edit instruction (reroll = variety)

widgets_values:
QWEN-EDIT DATASET TOOL ('kael') -- self-contained: it MAKES the hero, then re-poses it.
STAGE 1 (left): reroll 'Hero Seed' and watch HERO preview until you like the face (rendered
from this character's id tags in YOUR checkpoint, then face+hand DETAILED so it's crisp). Then
leave Hero Seed fixed on that value. (Reroll feels slow? mute the 'Face + Hand Detail' group.)
STAGE 2: leave 'Edit instruction' seed control = randomize; set batch count ~40 + Queue once
  -> output/dataset/kael/. Each frame = that DETAILED hero re-posed into a new framing/
  angle/pose/expression/background/lighting, same identity + art style. (mode 'populate': the
  bottom box shows the resolved prompt and re-rolls each queue; also expands headless via backend.)
Then curate the best 25-40 and run: ./dev train kael.
Wildcards (__angle__/__pose__/__expression__/__framing__/__background__/__lighting__) live in
  ComfyUI-Impact-Pack/wildcards/. Too slow / OOM? re-run ./dev models install il_graphs --variant quant=Q4_K_M.
Poses too similar? __pose__/__angle__ lead the instruction on purpose -- raise the multiple-angles
  LoRA toward 1.0, or drop a scene axis. Identity drifting? lower the multiple-angles LoRA.
QUALITY: the HERO is detailed up front (one pass) so every frame inherits a crisp face. If Qwen
  still softens faces, set QE_STAGE3_POLISH=True in il_graphs/graphs.py to ALSO detail each frame.
